routes.purpose: Complete XFlow UCL app linking and persist a verified ecosystem workspace UUID mapping for Crevux server requests.
routes.productionFailureMode: 400 for invalid/untrusted challenge or confirm URL; 503 when Crevux signing is not configured; no mapping is persisted until XFlow confirms server-to-server.
routes.notes: Does not return service tokens. Crevux stores XFlow workspace UUID only after XFlow confirms the signed app proof.

routes.purpose: Hosted control-plane configuration bootstrap.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for missing or invalid service token; never infer connected from URL presence.
routes.notes: Base URL env names differ today; Phase 2 should standardize aliases.

routes.purpose: Control-plane health/readiness check.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for invalid token; 503 for authority unavailable.
routes.notes: Status UI must not collapse configured/reachable/authenticated into one green state.

routes.purpose: XFlow OAuth authorization start.
routes.productionFailureMode: Reject invalid client_id, redirect_uri, state, nonce, PKCE, or returnTo.
routes.notes: Public route by design; must validate state/returnTo and registered callbacks.

routes.purpose: OAuth code-to-token exchange.
routes.productionFailureMode: 400/401 for invalid grant/client/PKCE; no raw secret details.
routes.notes: Client secret must remain server-side.

routes.purpose: OAuth user profile lookup.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401 for missing/expired OAuth token.
routes.notes: Do not accept service tokens here.

routes.purpose: Start UCL workspace/app linking.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for invalid connection token; 422 for missing workspace/app.
routes.notes: UCL route; validator requires UCL-style headers.

routes.purpose: Confirm UCL link with connection proof.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for invalid proof/token; fail closed.
routes.notes: Do not use global service tokens for per-connection proof.

routes.purpose: Ingest UCL activation/deployment/lifecycle events.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for invalid connection token; 409 for replay conflicts.
routes.notes: Activation/deployment event fields need Phase 2 schema hardening.

routes.purpose: Read Verixet-owned plan catalog.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 when unauthorized; consumers must not fall back to fake plan catalogs in production.
routes.notes: Phase 2 should replace local consumer plan catalogs with generated/mirrored Verixet data.

routes.purpose: Create Stripe checkout through Verixet authority.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403/422 for auth/schema failures; no local fallback checkout in production.
routes.notes: Stripe secret stays in Verixet only.

routes.purpose: Preview billing lifecycle impact before creating Stripe checkout sessions.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for unauthorized dashboard users; blocked_conflict or redundant_selection must not create checkout.
routes.notes: Deterministic preview only. Does not call Stripe and does not mutate subscriptions.

routes.purpose: Execute safe billing lifecycle changes after preview validation.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for unauthorized dashboard users; 409 for blocked/redundant/missing-context transitions; no silent duplicate subscription creation.
routes.notes: Runs plan-change preview first. Direct Stripe updates require one persisted subscription id and subscription item id; otherwise returns portal/manual resolution guidance.

routes.purpose: Validate public XFlow pricing handoff and redirect into Verixet signup-first checkout flow.
routes.productionFailureMode: 400 for unknown planSlug, unsupported billingInterval, mismatched scope/bundle/app, or unsupported sourceApp.
routes.notes: Accepts canonical Verixet plan slugs plus documented legacy XFlow bundle aliases; public intervals are monthly/yearly only. Bundle scope values include main4_bundle, creator_bundle, and ecosystem_bundle.

routes.purpose: Read workspace billing state.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403/404; UI must show unknown/unavailable instead of connected.
routes.notes: Consumers may cache display state only with clear freshness.

routes.purpose: Evaluate workspace entitlement/admission before protected work.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403/402/503; paid work must not execute before allowed response.
routes.notes: Phase 2 should standardize 402 PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED envelope.

routes.purpose: Stable service-to-service ecosystem account, billing lifecycle, app access, entitlement, usage, warning, and display status DTO for XFlow settings.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for missing or invalid service token; 400 for invalid sourceApp/workspace; 503 safe error when Verixet status cannot be composed.
routes.notes: Contract version 2026-05-ecosystem-status-v1. Usage is real Verixet ledger data when available, otherwise explicit unavailable state. Response must not expose raw Stripe customer, subscription, subscription item, payment method, or secret values.

routes.purpose: Trusted XFlow service handoff for Verixet-owned customer portal sessions or safe billing dashboard fallback.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403 for missing or invalid service token; 400 for invalid sourceApp or unsafe returnUrl; fallback to Verixet billing dashboard when Stripe/customer context is missing.
routes.notes: Verixet creates portal sessions server-side. XFlow receives only redirectUrl and never receives Stripe customer, subscription, subscription item, payment method, or secret values.

routes.purpose: Ingest app-scoped usage events into Verixet.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403/409/422; reject unscoped or mismatched app tokens.
routes.notes: Validated against ecosystem-contracts/types/usage-metrics.ts. Validator requires usage ingest routes to use an app-scoped token type.

routes.purpose: Start Verixet billing/signup handoff.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403/422; reject unsafe returnTo and unsupported app slugs.
routes.notes: App slugs must be canonical lowercase.

routes.purpose: Create or inspect a Crevux visual companion request from WordGeni.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403/402/422; must check entitlement before paid media work.
routes.notes: No root shared schema existed before this registry.

routes.purpose: Accept WordGeni integration requests into Crevux.
routes.productionFailureMode: 401/403/402/422; fail closed when Verixet admission is unavailable.
routes.notes: Shared-secret env must stay server-side; Phase 2 should refine token type if not control-plane service.

routes.purpose: Receive Stripe billing webhooks.
routes.productionFailureMode: 400 for invalid signature; idempotent replay handling required.
routes.notes: Verixet should be ecosystem billing webhook authority.

routes.purpose: Verixet signup with Turnstile validation.
routes.productionFailureMode: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY_MISSING, TURNSTILE_TOKEN_MISSING, TURNSTILE_SECRET_MISSING, or TURNSTILE_VALIDATION_FAILED.
routes.notes: Public route by design but must fail closed in production for Turnstile.
